items.name: FOA Checklist Extraction
items.description: Uploads a federal funding opportunity announcement (FOA / NOFO) and returns an RA-friendly Markdown FOA reference document covering FOA Summary, Key Dates and Deadlines, Funding Information, Eligibility Requirements, Application Components and Submission Requirements, Evaluation Process and Criteria, Program Priorities and Alignment, and Special Requirements. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping foa-checklist-extraction conventions with H1/H2/H3 hierarchical headings and a placement contract that routes each fact to exactly one section.

data.name: kb-context-lookup
data.query: federal funding opportunity announcement FOA NOFO eligibility budget cost sharing F&A indirect cost rates allowable unallowable personnel effort submission deadlines compliance evaluation criteria peer review CFDA program authorization

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200)
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary regulatory KB. Swap in NSF PAPPG Reference (NSF FOAs), NIH Grants Policy Statement (NIH NOFOs), DOE Financial Assistance Rules (DOE), or DOD Research Funding & DFARS (DOD) as appropriate for the announcement's sponsor.

data.name: extract-foa-summary
data.prompt:
You are extracting FOA summary fields. You receive the
uploaded document AND any KB chunks.

Emit a JSON object with: foa_number_or_id, cfda_number,
cfda_title, federal_agency, agency_office_bureau,
foa_title_or_program_name, program_authorization,
program_description (1-3 sentence summary). All STRINGS;
null when absent.

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-key-dates
data.prompt:
You are extracting key dates and deadlines from a FOA.
Preserve the sponsor's date format verbatim including time
and timezone.

Emit a JSON object with one key: critical_dates (JSON ARRAY
of {event_or_milestone, date_time, notes_or_requirements}
objects sorted chronologically).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-funding-information
data.prompt:
You are extracting funding information from a FOA. Preserve
monetary amounts verbatim ($X,XXX,XXX format).

Emit a JSON object with: total_funding (STRING), expected_awards
(STRING — e.g., "10-15"), award_size_range (STRING — e.g.,
"$100,000 to $500,000"), project_duration (STRING),
cost_sharing_required (BOOLEAN or null), cost_sharing_details
(STRING or null), award_instrument_type (STRING — Grant /
Cooperative Agreement / Contract).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-eligibility
data.prompt:
You are extracting eligibility requirements from a FOA.

Emit a JSON object with: eligible_applicants (JSON ARRAY of
STRINGS), ineligible_applicants (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS or
empty), per_institution_limit (STRING or null),
per_pi_limit (STRING or null), special_eligibility_conditions
(JSON ARRAY of STRINGS).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-application-and-evaluation
data.prompt:
You are extracting application components, submission
requirements, and evaluation criteria from a FOA.

Emit a JSON object with:
- registration_requirements: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS
  (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons, etc.).
- required_forms: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS.
- formatting_requirements: STRING (page limits, font,
  margins).
- required_components: JSON ARRAY of
  {component_name, description, page_limit_or_format}
  objects.
- submission_method: STRING (portal / email / hardcopy).
- screening_criteria: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS.
- merit_review_criteria: JSON ARRAY of
  {criterion, weight, description} objects.
- review_timeline: STRING.

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-priorities-and-special
data.prompt:
You are extracting program priorities and special requirements
from a FOA.

Emit a JSON object with: primary_goals (JSON ARRAY of
STRINGS), priority_areas (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
expected_outcomes (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
alignment_recommendations (STRING),
special_requirements (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS — unique aspects
not fitting other sections).

## Output
Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: foa-checklist-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the FOA Checklist
Extraction workflow. You receive SIX JSON object fragments
from the previous step:

1. FOA summary (foa_number_or_id, cfda_number, cfda_title,
   federal_agency, agency_office_bureau,
   foa_title_or_program_name, program_authorization,
   program_description)
2. Key dates (critical_dates: array of {event_or_milestone,
   date_time, notes_or_requirements})
3. Funding information (total_funding, expected_awards,
   award_size_range, project_duration, cost_sharing_required,
   cost_sharing_details, award_instrument_type)
4. Eligibility (eligible_applicants, ineligible_applicants,
   per_institution_limit, per_pi_limit,
   special_eligibility_conditions)
5. Application and evaluation (registration_requirements,
   required_forms, formatting_requirements,
   required_components, submission_method, screening_criteria,
   merit_review_criteria, review_timeline)
6. Priorities and special requirements (primary_goals,
   priority_areas, expected_outcomes,
   alignment_recommendations, special_requirements)

Your job is to render a single RA-friendly Markdown FOA
reference document for the sponsored-programs analyst (the
end-user). The deliverable is Markdown — NOT a JSON object
and NOT a JSON code fence. The audience is a research
administrator who will copy this into Word, paste into an
email to the proposal team, or save to a shared folder.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below.

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# FOA Reference: <foa_title_or_program_name>

**FOA Number/ID:** <foa_number_or_id or "Not specified">
**CFDA Number / Title:** <cfda_number or "Not specified"> — <cfda_title or "—">
**Federal Agency:** <federal_agency or "Not specified"> (<agency_office_bureau or "—">)
**Program Authorization:** <program_authorization or "Not specified">

<program_description as a paragraph; if null, write "Not specified in the document.">

---

## KEY DATES AND DEADLINES

A Markdown table with chronologically sorted rows:

| Event / Milestone | Date and Time | Notes / Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| (event_or_milestone) | (date_time) | (notes_or_requirements or "—") |

One row per critical_dates entry. Use **bold** for entries
labeled as critical, application, or final deadlines. If
critical_dates is empty, render a single row:
| — | — | No dates identified in the document |.

---

## FUNDING INFORMATION

Render as a definition-style list:

- **Total Available Funding:** <total_funding or "Not specified">
- **Number of Anticipated Awards:** <expected_awards or "Not specified">
- **Award Size:** <award_size_range or "Not specified">
- **Project Duration:** <project_duration or "Not specified">
- **Cost Sharing Required:** <"Yes" when cost_sharing_required is true, "No" when false, "Not specified" when null>
- **Cost Sharing Details:** <cost_sharing_details or "—">
- **Award Instrument Type:** <award_instrument_type or "Not specified">

---

## ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

### Who can apply

Render eligible_applicants as a bulleted list. Each entry is
a flat string — render it as a single bullet without
sub-bullets. If empty or null, state "Not specified in the
document".

### Who cannot apply

Render ineligible_applicants as a bulleted list of flat
strings. If empty or null, state "Not specified in the
document".

### Limitations

- **Per Institution:** <per_institution_limit or "Not specified">
- **Per PI:** <per_pi_limit or "Not specified">

### Special Eligibility Conditions

Render special_eligibility_conditions as a bulleted list of
flat strings. If empty or null, state "None beyond standard
federal requirements".

---

## APPLICATION COMPONENTS AND SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS

### Registration Requirements

Bulleted list of registration_requirements entries. Each
entry is a single flat-string bullet. If empty or null,
state "Not specified in the document".

### Required Forms

Bulleted list of required_forms entries. Each entry is a
single flat-string bullet. If empty or null, state "Not
specified in the document".

### Formatting Requirements

<formatting_requirements as a paragraph, or "Not specified in the document">

### Required Components Checklist

A Markdown table. Always present.

| Component | Description | Page Limit / Format |
|---|---|---|
| (component_name) | (description) | (page_limit_or_format or "—") |

One row per required_components entry. If empty or null,
render a single row:
| Not specified in this document | — | — |.

### Submission Method

<submission_method as a paragraph, or "Not specified in the document">

---

## EVALUATION PROCESS AND CRITERIA

### Screening Criteria

Render screening_criteria as a bulleted list of flat strings.
If empty or null, state "Not specified in the document".

### Merit Review Criteria

A Markdown table. Always present.

| Criterion | Weight | Description |
|---|---|---|
| (criterion) | (weight or "—") | (description or "—") |

One row per merit_review_criteria entry. If empty or null,
render a single row:
| Not specified in this document | — | — |.

### Review Timeline

<review_timeline as a paragraph, or "Not specified in the document">

---

## PROGRAM PRIORITIES AND ALIGNMENT

### Primary Goals

Render primary_goals as a bulleted list of flat strings. If
empty or null, state "Not specified in the document".

### Priority Areas

Render priority_areas as a bulleted list of flat strings. If
empty or null, state "Not specified in the document".

### Expected Outcomes

Render expected_outcomes as a bulleted list of flat strings.
If empty or null, state "Not specified in the document".

### Alignment Recommendations

<alignment_recommendations as a paragraph, or "Not specified in the document">

---

## SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

Render special_requirements as a bulleted list of flat
strings. If empty or null, state "None identified beyond
standard federal requirements."

---

## Placement contract (enforce as you render)

1. **Funding amounts, award counts, project duration, and
   cost-sharing details appear ONLY in FUNDING INFORMATION.**
   Even if other fragments mention them, do not restate
   elsewhere.
2. **Eligibility lists appear ONLY in ELIGIBILITY
   REQUIREMENTS.** Even if priorities or special-requirements
   fragments mention who can/cannot apply, do not duplicate.
3. **Per-component formatting rules (page limits, fonts,
   margins) appear ONLY in APPLICATION COMPONENTS / Required
   Components Checklist** (in the table's Page Limit / Format
   column). Not in SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS.
4. **Submission mechanics (portal, file format, naming)
   appear ONLY in APPLICATION COMPONENTS / Submission Method.**
   Not in SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS.
5. **Strategic priorities and alignment statements appear
   ONLY in PROGRAM PRIORITIES AND ALIGNMENT.** Not in PROGRAM
   AUTHORIZATION or SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS.
6. **Use ONLY the six JSON fragments above. Do NOT reference
   the original uploaded document directly.** If a field is
   absent from the fragments, render the appropriate
   placeholder — do not infer, fabricate, or pull from prior
   knowledge of the document text.

## Formatting rules

- Preserve the sponsor's monetary formatting verbatim
  ($1,234,567 or $0.5M).
- Preserve dates exactly as stated, including time and
  timezone components.
- Use **bold** for labels and critical action items.
- Use — (em dash) for empty optional fields in tables;
  "Not specified in the document" for empty required fields.
- If any field from a JSON fragment arrives as a nested
  object instead of a string, REWRITE it into natural-language
  prose before emitting — do NOT pass through {"key": "value"}
  syntax into the final Markdown.
- No JSON. No code fences around the output. No preamble.
  No closing commentary about the rendering. The output is
  the deliverable — render it as if you were writing the
  document directly.

validation_plan.name: Date / deadline preservation
validation_plan.description: Verify dates preserve the FOA's stated granularity and timezone.

validation_plan.name: Cross-field consistency
validation_plan.description: Verify expected_awards × max(award_range) ≤ total_funding when all three are stated.

validation_plan.name: Evaluation-criteria weights sum
validation_plan.description: Verify the sum of evaluation-criteria weights equals 100% when weights are stated as percentages.
